name: agent-kit
description: Generic skills, hooks and scripts for agents that work on a repository: reply templates and their lint, metrics skills, and a branch, pull request and check workflow.

plugins.name: reply-style
plugins.description: Reply templates for agents that report to a repository owner, with a lint and a Stop hook.

plugins.name: metrics
plugins.description: Two skills for a central metrics service: join it with a repository, and read its summary and act on it.

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: Branch, commit, pull request and check-reading workflow for agents, with one helper over the GitHub REST API.
